items.quote: To lower diffusion paths and increase the reaction rate during the calorimetric synthesis, samples were prepared with Cd and Pr powders. The metals were filed inside a glove box under Ar atmosphere (oxygen level: o1 ppm, water level: o1 ppm) to prevent oxidation. The metal powders were then weighed according to calculated amounts, mixed homogeneously and pressed into compact pellets.
